meta.model: BIZ-01 unit economics: revenue per 1 000 planned trips versus acquisition cost
meta.access_note: Cited web figures were found by web search on 2026-10-25. Direct page fetches were blocked by the sandbox egress policy, so every cited URL must be re-opened once by a human (and the partner terms re-read in the Travelpayouts dashboard after LEG-02) before the number goes into the deck.

S01.title: SPEC Версты, §1 метрики успеха (цель: клик на партнёра ≥ 8 % построенных поездок; ≥ 60 % установок строят маршрут), §14 монетизация (в MVP нет оплат внутри приложения)

S02.title: Бэклог investor-readiness, BIZ-01 (оценка ревью: 8 % × ~10 % × ~12 000 ₽ × 8 %), BIZ-03, BIZ-04, TEAM-01

S03.title: Цены по умолчанию в движке Версты: lodgingNightByPopulation 4 000 / 5 000 / 7 000 ₽ (города < 100 тыс. / 100 тыс.–1 млн / > 1 млн), asOf 2026-10-01; семейный номер ×1,4; номеров = ceil(взрослых / 2); 4 готовых маршрута на 1–3 ночи

S04.title: Travelpayouts, оффер «Яндекс Путешествия»: 8 % от стоимости брони отеля в России (3 % за рубежом, 5 % ж/д); засчитывается оплата в течение 30 дней после перехода; вознаграждение подтверждается через 2 дня после выезда; отменённые брони и сторонние промокоды не учитываются

S05.title: Travelpayouts, оффер «Ostrovok.ru»: 6 % от стоимости брони; переход засчитывается, только если он был до открытия формы бронирования; срок cookie в найденном тексте не указан

S06.title: Travelpayouts, оффер «Tripster»: 10 % за экскурсию, 8 % за билеты в музеи, 4 % за многодневные туры; средний чек 7 600 (₽ по контексту); cookie 90 дней

S07.title: Справка Travelpayouts: срок cookie у большинства брендов 30 дней (точный — во вкладке About программы); атрибуция по последнему клику

S08.title: Яндекс Путешествия, «Итоги 2025 года»: средняя ночь в отеле по России 6 858 ₽; Центральный федеральный округ 6 970 ₽

S09.title: Газета.ru: города Золотого кольца — средняя ночь ≈ 8 000 ₽ (+14 % г/г), Ярославль ≈ 7 800 ₽

S10.title: РИА Новости: бронирования на бархатный сезон 2026 — в среднем ≈ 6 200 ₽ за ночь (−9 % г/г)

S11.title: Яндекс Путешествия для отельеров: базовая комиссия 15 % → 17 % с 01.02.2026 (контекст: условия Яндекса и партнёрок меняются)

S12.title: Т—Ж: новые правила для гостиниц с 01.03.2026 — полный возврат предоплаты при отмене до дня заезда

S13.title: RuStore, платежи в приложении: комиссия магазина 15 %; с 01.02.2026 самозанятые и физлица не могут продавать через биллинг RuStore (нужны ИП или ООО)

S14.title: RevenueCat, бенчмарки подписочных приложений 2026: freemium — доля скачиваний с оплатой к 35-му дню ≈ 2,1 % (мир, все категории)

S15.title: Ориентиры CPI (блоги, низкая надёжность, категории «путешествия» нет): журнал Битрикс24 — e-commerce 108–172 ₽, финансы 129–198 ₽, игры 231–289 ₽ за установку; VK: у приложений из RuStore в VK Рекламе CPI в первых тестах ниже на ≈ 20 %

S16.title: Налоги: УСН «доходы» 6 % (НК РФ, ст. 346.20 п. 1); НПД 6 % с доходов от юрлиц и ИП (422-ФЗ, ст. 10)

S17.title: Журнал решений D-IR-03: бюджет теста рекламы VAL-02 по умолчанию 30 000 ₽ (нужно одобрение CEO)

S18.title: Архитектура §12.2: ВМ-A 4 vCPU / 8 ГБ + ВМ-B 8 vCPU / 32 ГБ (GraphHopper + Photon + тайлы) + еженедельная временная ВМ сборки; провайдер Selectel или Yandex Cloud (решение CEO)

hotel_ctr.label_ru: Отели: доля поездок с кликом «Забронировать ночь»
hotel_ctr.reasoning: Base = SPEC §1 target (a target, not a measurement). Conservative assumes a demo-quality first release where many trips are day trips with no overnight; optimistic assumes ready routes dominate (all 4 have ≥ 1 night). Measure: ENG-05 event hotel_link_clicked / plan_succeeded in VAL-04.

hotel_booking_conversion.label_ru: Отели: доля кликнувших поездок с оплаченной бронью
hotel_booking_conversion.unit: share of trips with a hotel click
hotel_booking_conversion.reasoning: The review used ~10 %. No credible public click-to-booking benchmark for Yandex Travel via Travelpayouts was found (searched 2026-10-25). Verst's click is high-intent (dates, guests and town prefilled) but the user often already has a favourite booking app. Measure: Travelpayouts statistics by sub-id / hotel clicks (VAL-04, M5).

hotel_price_night.label_ru: Отели: цена ночи за номер экипажа
hotel_price_night.reasoning: Conservative = engine default for a 100k–1M town (standard room); the engine's lodging_cheap knob pushes families to cheaper hotels. Base = Яндекс Путешествия 2025 average for the Central Federal District (6 970 ₽); cross-check: engine family room 5 000 × 1.4 = 7 000 ₽. Optimistic = Golden Ring 2025 average (Газета.ru, ≈ 8 000 ₽). Measure: price bucket of hotel_link_clicked + partner order value.

hotel_nights_per_booking.reasoning: The link books one night per overnight town (checkout = check-in + 1, architecture §links). Engine ready routes: 3 of 4 have 1 night, the Golden Ring 2–3 nights → mean ≈ 1.4 nights per trip; some users book only one of two towns through Verst. Measure: partner order nights.

hotel_season_price_index.label_ru: Сезонность: индекс цены ночи в моделируемом месяце
hotel_season_price_index.reasoning: Conservative models an off-peak month: velvet-season 2026 bookings ≈ 6 200 ₽ vs 2025 annual 6 858 ₽ → 0.90 (two different sources and years; arithmetic only). Base and optimistic use the annual average; the optimistic price is already a peak-destination figure, so no extra uplift (no double counting). Volume seasonality is the separate input low_month_volume_index.

hotel_cancellation_rate.reasoning: Travelpayouts pays only for completed stays (S04). No credible 2025–2026 Russian cancellation statistic was found. Since 2026-03-01 a guest gets a full refund until the check-in day (S12), which makes cancelling free and likely raises the rate. Measure: confirmed vs created orders in Travelpayouts statistics.

hotel_attribution_leakage.unit: share of Verst-driven bookings not credited
hotel_attribution_leakage.reasoning: Attribution is a 30-day web cookie with last-click (S04, S07). Losses: (1) Android may open travel.yandex.ru links in the installed Яндекс Путешествия / Яндекс app, where the browser cookie is absent; (2) the user returns later from another device or directly in the app; (3) a cashback or coupon site's link wins last click; (4) third-party promo codes void the reward. Range is reasoned, not measured. Measure: ENG-03 test booking through the installed app + ratio of Verst-reported bookings (VAL-04 post-trip question) to partner-credited bookings.

hotel_commission.reasoning: Base/optimistic = Яндекс Путешествия via Travelpayouts, 8 % for hotels in Russia (S04). Conservative = Ostrovok.ru via Travelpayouts, 6 % (S05) — the ENG-03 fallback if Yandex terms or attribution are poor; also covers a cut of the Yandex rate (Yandex raised hotel-side commission in Feb 2026, S11, so terms do move).

exc_ctr.label_ru: Экскурсии: доля поездок с кликом на Tripster
exc_ctr.reasoning: Only sights with a tripster_id show the button (SPEC §14); a road-trip family mostly self-guides. Set at a quarter to a third of the hotel click rate. Measure: excursion_link_clicked / plan_succeeded.

exc_conversion.label_ru: Экскурсии: доля кликов с оплаченной экскурсией
exc_conversion.unit: share of trips with an excursion click
exc_conversion.reasoning: No public Tripster conversion benchmark found. Lower than hotels: an excursion is optional, a bed is not. Measure: Travelpayouts Tripster statistics by sub-id.

exc_avg_check.reasoning: Base = average check 7 600 on the Travelpayouts Tripster card (network-wide, includes trips abroad; currency ₽ by context). Conservative = a short town walk for a family (SPEC shows «Экскурсия от 1 900 ₽» per person).

exc_loss_rate.reasoning: 90-day cookie (S06) and no dominant competing app make leakage lower than for hotels; weather cancellations remain.

exc_commission.reasoning: 10 % per excursion (8 % museum tickets, 4 % multi-day tours) on the Travelpayouts Tripster card.

pro_planner_to_paid.label_ru: Trip Pro: доля активных пользователей, купивших Pro
pro_planner_to_paid.reasoning: Conservative (planning case) = 0: SPEC §14 ships no in-app payments in the MVP, and RuStore billing needs an ИП/ООО (S13), so no Pro cash inside the planning horizon. Base = 1 % of activated users, an assumption. Optimistic = RevenueCat global freemium download-to-paid by day 35 (2.1 %, S14) applied to activated users; the benchmark is mostly iOS / Western markets, so for an Android app in Russia it is an upper bound. Revenue is booked once per payer per year and spread over that payer's planned trips. Measure: BIZ-06 waitlist rate per price point (intent, not payment).

pro_price_year.unit: RUB per paying user per year
pro_price_year.reasoning: Placeholder price points for the BIZ-06 three-price test; revenue is booked once per payer per year and spread over that payer's planned trips.

store_fee.reasoning: RuStore commission 15 %; RuStore billing needs an ИП or ООО since 2026-02-01 (affects LEG-02).

cpi.label_ru: Привлечение: цена установки (VK Реклама / Яндекс Директ)
cpi.reasoning: assumed — VAL-02 will measure. No credible public CPI for Russian travel apps on VK Реклама or Яндекс Директ was found; only blog ranges for other categories (108–289 ₽, S15). Range set inside those references. VAL-02 measures cost per landing lead, which is not a CPI either: the first real CPI comes from the RuStore beta campaign.

install_to_planner.reasoning: Base = SPEC §1 target «≥ 60 % of installs build ≥ 1 route» (a target, not a measurement). Measure: AppMetrica install → plan_succeeded (ENG-05).

trips_per_planner.label_ru: Воронка: поездок на активного пользователя (90 дней)
trips_per_planner.reasoning: A family plans few car trips per season; repeat planning (alternatives, re-plans) counts as one trip_id only if saved as a new trip. Measure: distinct trip_id per device in 90 days.

revenue_tax_rate.reasoning: Both entity options in LEG-02 tax this income at 6 %. VAT is not modelled (not due at this revenue scale; re-check if revenue grows).

b2g_pilots_per_year.reasoning: BIZ-03 target is ≥ 1 pilot «paid or free with a paid follow-up»; the planning case counts it as free.

b2g_revenue_per_pilot.reasoning: No public price for a curated-route placement was found. Placeholder for one region's promotion of one route with analytics; per-contract, not per trip. Measure: BIZ-03 offers and replies.

sponsored_businesses.reasoning: BIZ-04 target is ≥ 3 businesses agreeing to a test (a test may be free, hence 0 in the planning case). Ads must carry 38-FZ labelling.

sponsored_fee_month.label_ru: Спонсорские остановки: плата точки в месяц
sponsored_fee_month.reasoning: Placeholder for a roadside cafe or fuel station on one corridor. Measure: BIZ-04 answers on price.

burn_hosting.label_ru: Расходы: хостинг (2 ВМ в РФ + сборка + бэкапы)
burn_hosting.reasoning: Sizing from architecture §12.2 (4/8 + 8/32 VMs, weekly 16/64 spot build). No provider quote yet (CEO decision Q-3); replace with the Selectel / Yandex Cloud calculator figure.

burn_curator.reasoning: TEAM-01 part-time paid curator (verification calls, photos, tags). Replace with the signed contract amount.

burn_ads.reasoning: Same in all scenarios so scenarios compare unit economics, not budgets: the D-IR-03 test budget (not yet approved) repeated monthly.

burn_accounting.reasoning: Online accounting + bank account for an ИП on УСН. Replace with the chosen bank's tariff.

burn_tools.label_ru: Расходы: домены, почта, сервисы, маркировка рекламы
burn_tools.reasoning: AppMetrica and Travelpayouts are free; this covers domains, mail, monitoring and ERID labelling costs. Founder and developer pay are excluded (see the note in unit-economics.md).

low_month_volume_index.label_ru: Сезонность: поездок в слабый месяц к среднему месяцу
low_month_volume_index.reasoning: Car trips concentrate in May–September and holiday weekends; no monthly series for road trips in Russia was found. Used only for the cash-planning line «trips per average month so that the weakest month also breaks even». Measure: plan_succeeded by month over the first year.

licensing.note: Excluded from per-trip revenue: a B2B licence is priced per contract and does not scale with Verst's own planned trips. Modelled after BIZ-05 calls give price expectations.
licensing.note_ru: B2B-лицензия оценивается по договору и не растёт с числом поездок в самой Версте; модель появится после звонков BIZ-05 с ожиданиями по цене.
